entries.en: to file; to sharpen with a file

entries.zh: 用砂輪（轉輪）磨利刀器；車刀一類刀具的研磨
entries.en: to sharpen (a blade) on a grinding wheel
entries.notes: H 欄作工具名「車刀」，L 卻是「以輪磨刀」的動作，名動有落差，義項仍相合。
H 欄標[疑:唱/喙]，磨刀義主要靠 L 的 nabaja（剃刀）定奪。

entries.zh: 告誡；規勸糾正（兼含教導）
entries.en: to admonish; to correct; to teach
to admonish verbally; to speak a warning

entries.zh: 講說道理以規勸；講道訓誨
entries.en: to admonish by expounding reason; to preach
to admonish amicably; to advise kindly
to admonish with reason; to reason with (someone)

entries.zh: 寬和教諭；從寬教導規勸
entries.en: to admonish with leniency; to instruct gently

entries.zh: 教化勸諭；勸化（以教導使人向善）
entries.en: to admonish so as to reform; to instruct and convert
entries.notes: L 欄有[残]，只剩 buens（當為「對好人」），義依 H「化諭」與 M/R 對音定。

entries.zh: 於教堂宣讀婚配公告（婚前公告，徵詢有無異議）
entries.en: to publish the banns of marriage in church
entries.notes: H 標[疑:叫/叼]，R 欄「禮」聲調 T99 污損難辨，義由 L「將婚者」的教堂語境定。

entries.en: to pile up; to heap together
to heap together into one pile

entries.notes: H 作「私已愛」（已通己），L 兩條同作 amor por amor，私愛義依 H 定。

entries.en: to shroud and lay out a corpse; to prepare a body for burial
entries.notes: L 拼作 amorrajâr，實即 amortajar（殮），H「殮」與 M/R 對音互證。

entries.en: to encoffin; to lay a body in the coffin
entries.notes: L 拼作 amor fajâr（亦即 amortajar），H「棺殮」定其入棺收殮義。
